def.short: speaking and acting in a way that shows respect for other people
def.long: Speaking and acting in a way that shows respect for other people, for example by saying please and thank you. Being polite is important when you meet someone for the first time.

examples.en: It's polite to say thank you.
The waiter was very polite to us.
Please be polite when you talk to the customers.

etymology.text: From Latin 'politus', meaning 'polished' (from 'polire', to polish): a polite person has smooth, polished manners.

tr.note: 'Polite' davranışla ilgilidir (kibarca konuşmak, teşekkür etmek). Kalpten gelen iyilik için 'kind' kullanılır; ikisini karıştırma.

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'bir' zorunlu değil ama İngilizcede tekil sayılabilir isimden önce 'a/an' gerekir.

quiz.cloze: Be ______ to the guests and say hello.

def.short: speaking or acting in a way that is not polite and may upset people
def.long: Speaking or acting in a way that is not polite and may upset or hurt other people. Looking at your phone while someone talks to you can seem rude.

examples.en: It's rude to talk with your mouth full.
The man was rude to the waiter.
Sorry, I didn't mean to be rude.

etymology.text: From Latin 'rudis', meaning rough or unworked. The 'not polite' sense grew from the idea of rough, uneducated behavior.

tr.note: 'Rude' = nezaketsiz, insanı kıracak kadar kaba; küfür demek değildir. 'Terbiyesiz' daha sert bir kelimedir.

mistakes.why: 'Bana kaba davranıyor' için 'rude to' kullanılır; 'with' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: Don't be ______. Say please and thank you.

def.short: telling the truth and not cheating or stealing
def.long: Always telling the truth and not cheating or stealing. An honest person says what they really think, even when it is hard.

examples.en: Please be honest. Do you like my haircut?
examples.tr: Lütfen dürüst ol. Saç kesimimi beğendin mi?

examples.en: The shop owner was honest and gave back my money.
examples.tr: Dükkân sahibi dürüsttü ve paramı geri verdi.

examples.en: She is an honest person, so I trust her.
examples.tr: Dürüst biri, o yüzden ona güveniyorum.

etymology.text: From Latin 'honestus', meaning 'honorable', from 'honor' (respect, honor). The 'h' was dropped in speech through French.

tr.note: 'Honest' kelimesinde 'h' okunmaz, 'onist' gibi söylenir. Bu yüzden 'an honest man' denir.

mistakes.why: 'Honest' sessiz h ile başlar ve ünlü sesiyle okunur; bu yüzden 'a' değil 'an' kullanılır.

tr.mnemonic: H okunmaz: 'onist'. 'An honest man' - ses ünlü ile başlar.

quiz.cloze: A good friend is ______ with you, even when it's hard.

def.micro: not wanting to work or move
def.short: not willing to work or use energy; liking to do nothing
def.long: Not willing to work or use energy, and liking to rest or do nothing. A lazy day, however, can mean a day when you relax on purpose.

examples.en: I'm too lazy to cook tonight.
My brother is lazy and never cleans his room.
We had a lazy Sunday and watched films all day.
examples.tr: Tembel bir pazar geçirdik; bütün gün film izledik.

tr.note: 'Lazy' kişi için olumsuzdur; ama 'a lazy Sunday' = işsiz güçsüz, keyifli bir pazar gibi olumlu da olabilir.

mistakes.right: I'm too lazy to cook tonight.
mistakes.why: 'Yapmaya üşenmek' için 'too lazy to + fiil' kalıbı kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: He never helps at home. He is so ______.

def.short: nervous or quiet when you are with people you do not know well
def.long: Feeling nervous or quiet when you are with people you do not know well. A shy person may not like to speak in front of a group.

examples.en: My little brother is very shy.
She was too shy to ask the teacher.
Don't be shy. Come and sit with us.

tr.note: 'Shy' bir kişilik özelliğidir (utangaç). Belli bir anda mahcup olmak için 'embarrassed' kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: She is ______ and doesn't talk much in class.

def.short: ready to do something difficult or scary without showing fear
def.long: Ready to do something difficult, dangerous, or scary without showing fear. You can be brave in a big way, like saving someone, or in a small way, like telling the truth.

examples.en: The brave boy jumped into the water.
You were so brave at the dentist today.
It was brave of her to speak first.
examples.tr: İlk önce konuşması cesurca bir davranıştı.

tr.note: 'Be brave!' = Cesur ol! / Dayan! Genelde zor bir an öncesinde, özellikle çocuklara söylenir.

def.short: happy to give more money, time, or help than people expect
def.long: Happy to give money, time, or help to other people, often more than is needed. A generous person does not mind sharing.

examples.en: My uncle is very generous with his time.
examples.tr: Amcam, zaman ayırma konusunda çok cömerttir.

examples.en: She left a generous tip for the waiter.
Thank you for the generous gift!
examples.tr: Bu kadar cömert bir hediye için teşekkürler!

etymology.text: From Latin 'generosus', meaning 'of noble birth'. The meaning 'giving freely' developed later.

tr.note: 'Generous' kişi için ('cömert biri'), ama hediye, bahşiş ve porsiyon için de ('a generous portion' = bol porsiyon) kullanılır.

quiz.cloze: Thank you for paying for dinner. You are very ______.

def.short: able to wait or deal with problems without getting angry
def.long: Able to wait, or to deal with difficult people or slow things, without getting angry or upset. Teachers and parents often need to be patient.

examples.en: Please be patient. The doctor will see you soon.
examples.tr: Lütfen sabırlı olun. Doktor sizi birazdan alacak.

examples.en: My dad is very patient with the kids.
She isn't patient, so she hates waiting in line.
examples.tr: Sabırlı değil, bu yüzden sırada beklemekten nefret eder.

tr.note: Aynı yazılan 'patient' isim olarak 'hasta' demektir (a doctor's patient). Burada sıfat: sabırlı.

mistakes.why: 'Bana karşı sabırlı ol' için 'patient with sb' kullanılır; 'to' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: A good teacher is ______ with young children.

def.short: not willing to change your mind, even when others say you are wrong
def.long: Not willing to change your mind or your way of doing things, even when other people give good reasons. Stubborn people often say 'No' again and again.

examples.en: My grandfather is too stubborn to see a doctor.
Don't be so stubborn. Just say sorry.
examples.tr: O kadar inatçı olma. Sadece özür dile.

examples.en: The child was stubborn and refused to wear a coat.
examples.tr: Çocuk inat etti ve montunu giymeyi reddetti.

tr.note: Türkçe 'inatçı' ile aynı anlamda; çoğu zaman olumsuz bir özelliktir. 'Obstinate' daha resmî ve yazılı dildir.

quiz.cloze: He is so ______. He never listens to anyone's advice.

def.short: caring only about yourself and not about other people
def.long: Caring only about yourself and what you want, and not thinking about what other people need. A selfish person does not like to share.

examples.en: It was selfish to take the last piece of cake.
Don't be selfish. Share your toys with your sister.
examples.tr: Bencil olma. Oyuncaklarını kız kardeşinle paylaş.

examples.en: He is selfish and never helps his friends.
examples.tr: Bencil biri; arkadaşlarına hiç yardım etmez.

tr.note: Türkçede 'egoist' de aynı anlamda kullanılır. Ama İngilizcede 'egoist' çok az kullanılır; 'selfish' en doğal kelimedir.
tr.mnemonic: Self-ish: 'self' = kendi. Yalnızca kendini düşünen kişi.

quiz.cloze: She never shares anything. She is so ______.
